Description: Collection or term name not found in the active metadata graph.
Parser encountered a node/operator that is not implemented or was used as a column instead of a function.
Example: PyDough nodes WEEK is not callable. Did you mean to use a function?

Description: Runtime problem during SQL or Python execution (syntax error, multi-statement limit, etc.).
Example: SQLite Error: You can only execute one statement at a time.

Description: Breaks graph ancestry or key-mapping rules between collections.
Example: Cannot reference ancestor collection 'orders' from current scope.

Description: Operation expected a singular row but got many (or vice-versa).
Example: Expected all terms in CALCULATE(...) to be singular.

Description: Expression vs. collection type mismatch or other type misclassification.
Example: Expected an expression, but received a collection 'orders'.

Description: Operands cannot be coerced to the required logical or arithmetic type.
Example: PyDough code cannot be treated as a boolean.

Description: Optimizer produced a cyclic plan / recursion overflow.
Example: maximum recursion depth exceeded while calling a Python object

Description: Error did not match any known pattern (fallback).
Empty exception cell; indicates success or missing log.
